text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Steadily gaining fame, one day, as her 
challenges in the Classic Year drew to a 
close..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer! Let's go watch that 
race called the "Arima Kinen"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. A high-profile race 
where the most popular Umamusume are 
chosen by fan vote to compete."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I heard both Spe-chan and Grass-chan are 
running! They were working super hard in 
training!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan said she was planning to go 
watch! So I want to go too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching top-class running might have a 
positive influence on Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I came to watch the feverish excitement 
of the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (*Chatter, chatter...*) (*Buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, they're super popular! Spe-chan and 
the others are gonna run here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, Grass Wonder. Both are this 
year's most high-profile Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And guess what, we're gonna run with the 
upperclassmen! Isn't that awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm super, super excited! Can't it start 
already~? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, the Umamusume running in the 
race began to enter the track.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Hey, Spe-cha—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know... Spe-chan's expression looks a 
bit different than usual.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You have a bit of a scary look on your 
face. Even though you get to run in front 
of everyone, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nervous...? Hmm, I don't really know.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really hope she does her best! 
You can do it, Spe-chan—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the Arima Kinen got underway!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The results are in! The winner is... 
Grass Wonder! It's Grass Wonder!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Special Week was so close! She falls just 
short by the slimmest of margins!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And... I was so close. Just half a step 
more, and I would've had it...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Ugh, uuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan... thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Grass-chan...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I was supposed to win overwhelmingly. 
I... can't let it end like this."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't let it end here either! Next 
time, I'm definitely going to beat 
Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I will be waiting. At the end of 
next year... right here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Waaah~! Amazing, this is so, so 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Both Spe-chan and Grass-chan are sooooooo 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My heart is pounding so hard! Why? Why is 
it doing that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week and Grass Wonder, who showed 
us what a true, serious match looks like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, an emotion awakened within 
Haru Urara. Surely, that was—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I get it now! It's because of the 
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Arima Kinen must be so much 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why my heart was racing too! 
Alright, my mind's made up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
――I'm, in the Arima Kinen! I'm gonna 
runーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~ !?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I just heard 'Arima Kinen'... Wait, 
Haru Urara said that?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, are you serious? There's no 
way that's happening...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Haru Urara's energetic 
declaration, the post-race buzz in the 
crowd gradually turned into a chorus of 
bewildered murmurs...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, as a Trainer, having a target 
race set is something to celebrate. 
...Even if it's a difficult goal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's what Haru Urara has decided— then 
I want to support her with everything I've 
got!
choice_data_list:
It's going to be a very harsh road, but 
are you prepared for it?

It's going to be a very harsh road, but 
are you prepared for it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm full of motivation!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ei! Ho ho ho! See, I've got plenty of 
energy!
choice_data_list:
...Make sure you get plenty of results in 
your races, alright?

...Make sure you get plenty of results in 
your races, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, for Haru Urara to aim for the Arima 
Kinen right now, she'll need to rack up 
serious results in graded stakes races."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's the same as usual, right? I 
just gotta run a whole bunch! I'll be 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I can't wait for the Arima Kinen! I 
wish next year would hurry up and get 
here♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll believe in Haru Urara's 
determination." With a grand goal decided, 
our challenge in the Classic Year came to 
an end.
